verdict.rationale: Docs claim traces/logs can be searched and filtered by any span attribute or log field, including arbitrary high-cardinality values like user_id/request_id, without requiring pre-defined indexes (signoz-docs-3, signoz-docs-7). However, community hands-on reports on SigNoz's ClickHouse schema find that accessing map attributes (the mechanism used for flexible, high-cardinality fields) is 10-50x slower than regular columns, indicating real performance limitations for exactly this use case (signoz-comm-6, signoz-comm-7). Missing for 10: first-party benchmarks or documentation addressing high-cardinality query performance, and confirmation that no manual indexing/materialized views are needed in practice.
